rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Enzyme = globular protein biocatalyst; features in three lines: enormous rate enhancement, high specificity (lock and key / induced fit), work under mild conditions (T ~37 °C, near-neutral pH).  ·  Trick 2: Classification by reaction: oxidoreductase, transferase, hydrolase, lyase, isomerase, ligase — quote the six names for the classification mark.
